title: Weekly Parking Maximum Worksheet: The Stay's Parking Maximum and the Excess Taken Off (Guest Folios)
content:
The excess taken off a Guest Folio under the Ashbury weekly parking maximum is worked out from the parking lines of the stay.

## Definitions

1. **Nights parked.** The nights parked are counted as the parking lines of the stay, one line for each night the guest's vehicle was parked: every self-parking line and every valet line of the folio. The minimum nights parked is 7.
2. **The excess.** The excess is the parking of the stay, every self-parking and valet line less the corrections those lines already carry, less the stay's parking maximum, never below zero and rounded half up to the cent at the end; a stay with fewer than the minimum nights parked has no excess.
3. **The weekly rate.** The weekly rate is the weekly basis rate times the chargeable nights per week.
4. **The stay's parking maximum.** The stay's parking maximum is the weekly rate for each full week of nights parked plus the weekly basis rate for each remaining night parked, rounded half up to the cent. A full week is 7 nights parked; the remaining nights are those left over after the full weeks.
5. **The weekly basis rate and the chargeable nights.** The weekly basis rate is the rate of the service parked on the most recent night parked, and the chargeable nights per week are the standard chargeable nights, 6. When the most recent night parked carries both a self-parking and a valet line, the service of that night is valet.

The rates are the brand's self-parking rate and valet rate per night parked, as shown in the brand parking schedule. The corrections the lines already carry are every adjustment already standing against the stay's self-parking and valet lines.

## Worked example (hypothetical brand rates: self-parking $40.00, valet $60.00)

A stay with nine self-parking lines of $40.00, whose self-parking lines already carry corrections of $12.00 in total:

1. Nights parked: 9, which is not fewer than 7.
2. Parking of the stay: 9 times $40.00 is $360.00, less $12.00 of corrections, $348.00.
3. Weekly basis rate: the most recent night parked was self-parking, $40.00. Weekly rate: $40.00 times 6, $240.00.
4. Stay's parking maximum: one full week at $240.00 plus 2 remaining nights at $40.00, $320.00.
5. Excess: $348.00 less $320.00, **$28.00**.

## Further cases (same hypothetical rates)

| Hypothetical stay | Nights parked | Basis rate | Maximum | Parking of the stay | Excess |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Six self-parking lines | 6 | — | — | $240.00 | None: fewer than 7 nights parked |
| Six self-parking lines, then two valet lines | 8 | $60.00 (last night valet) | $360.00 plus $60.00, $420.00 | $360.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) |
| Fourteen self-parking lines, no corrections | 14 | $40.00 | Two full weeks, $480.00 | $560.00 | $80.00 |
| Last night carries both a self-parking and a valet line | — | $60.00 (that night's service is valet) | — | — | — |
